main_text.p: Redite, conseruósque Dεstros, & simul Curate commissos fidei Dεstr& greges.

Vitate rixas atque fœda turgia, Summiquε prouidam inuocate Numinis Benignitatem, vt Abraha Vελit pecus Augere semper, illiúsque commoda Vbique promouere serujentibus Vobis fideliter, Dεlut bonos decet Vernas, quibus herus contigit Dei timens, Malaq; fraudis abstinens, quo mitior Meliorque nullus orbe cuncto cernitur. Nec qui magis fua fatagat familia Puras falutis indicare semitas, Cultúsque Rectori placentes Cælitum.
main_text.head: PASTORES.
main_text.p: Parere nos æquum est tibi: nec gratius Quicquam esse nobis censeas quàm commodis Seruire cunctis Abrahæ, & domum ipsius Gazis repletam conspicari ditibus, Parata nobis cuncta sunt, mox ibimus.
main_text.head: ISAACVS.
main_text.p: Quid me, precor, relinquitis? me sumite Vobis comitem, nostros vt aspiciam greges.
main_text.head: PASTORES.
main_text.p: Isaace mane, nec adibus patris procul Abscede, ne tuam ferat molestius Absentiam, & nobis grauiter succensere at. Sed firmior postquam tibi atas auxerit Robur, licebit experiri, quos boni

page.notes: Catchword-like marks at the foot left out; the first verse line includes the word "Dεstros" and "Dεlut" as printed, which are doubtful readings for "Dεstros" (Pastros/Pastores) and "Dεlut" (Velut); "Vελit" is likely "Vult". Some words in the bottom line are damaged by stains and may be incomplete.
